newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tuesday trading hours for Shanghai exchanges.
newsitem.headline: Tuesday trading hours for Shanghai exchanges.

text.p: The Shenzhen stock exchange will trade normally on Tuesday despite the funeral for the late Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping, an exchange spokesman said on Monday.
"Trading will go on normally," the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Earlier, a spokesman for the Shanghai stock exchange said the exchange would also trade normally on Tuesday.
Beijing has announced that the funeral will start at 10:00 a.m. (0200 GMT) on Tuesday.
The Shanghai-based China Foreign Exchange Trade System, an interbank market, will alter trading hours on Tuesday due to the funeral for late Chinese leader Deng Xiaoping, an exchange spokesman said.

Trading will start at 09:20 a.m. (0120 GMT) as usual but will be suspended for one hour from 10:00 a.m. (0200 GMT). The one-hour loss will be compensated for by adding trading from 11:00 to 12:00 a.m (0300 to 0400 GMT), the spokesman said.
The Shanghai Metal Exchange will cancel trading sessions between 9:45 a.m. and 10:55 (0145 GMT and 0255 GMT), an exchange statement said on Monday.
